name: Commander
description: Runs the watch rotation and the chain of command.

advice.steady: {name}, the {skill_band} {post}, asks what precedent this choice leaves for the next watch.
advice.novice: {name} admits command has not yet taught them every cost, and urges room to revise the order.
advice.expert: {name} has seen enough councils to warn that a clean order may still leave a divided crew.
advice.strained: The chain of command is already frayed; {name} warns that an order nobody can enforce is only theatre.
advice.faction_aligned: As one of the {faction}, {name} knows the largest voice aboard will expect to be heard.
advice.reputation: {name} cautions that the ship's established name will shape how any order is received.
advice.obligation: {name} sets {obligation} beside the proposal: an old promise will judge the new one.
advice.vacant: The Commander post is vacant; no named officer can speak for command continuity.

name: Engineer
description: Keeps the reactor lit and the hull honest.

advice.steady: {name}, the {skill_band} {post}, asks which systems can bear the strain and which cannot.
advice.novice: {name} can name the immediate load, but warns that hidden faults may outlast this decision.
advice.expert: {name} separates the repair that buys time from the rebuild that preserves the ship.
advice.strained: The engineering craft is thin or the bay is failing; {name} warns that promised margins may not exist.
advice.faction_aligned: The {faction} trust {name}'s workshops, giving this warning unusual weight below decks.
advice.reputation: {name} notes that suppliers and rivals already believe they know what risks this ship accepts.
advice.obligation: {name} points to {obligation}: the ledger may already claim the parts or labour under discussion.
advice.vacant: The Engineer post is vacant; the council has no serving engineer to certify the risk.

name: Medic
description: Guards the health of a sealed-city population.

advice.steady: {name}, the {skill_band} {post}, asks who carries the bodily cost and who gets time to recover.
advice.novice: {name} warns that the symptoms are clearer than the long consequences.
advice.expert: {name} distinguishes the lives saved now from the health debt passed to the next generation.
advice.strained: The medical line is depleted; {name} warns that even a sound protocol may exceed the wards' reach.
advice.faction_aligned: The {faction} will hear {name}'s triage as the judgement of one of their own.
advice.reputation: {name} reminds the council that patients arrive expecting the mercy—or severity—the ship is known for.
advice.obligation: {name} will not discuss this case without naming {obligation}, whose beneficiaries may be placed at risk.
advice.vacant: The Medic post is vacant; no serving physician can speak for the likely human cost.

name: Scientist
description: Reads the void and the genome alike.

advice.steady: {name}, the {skill_band} {post}, separates what the evidence shows from what the council merely hopes.
advice.novice: {name} asks for caution: the first explanation is plausible, not proven.
advice.expert: {name} identifies the uncertainty worth buying down and the uncertainty no instrument can remove.
advice.strained: The ship's research craft is eroded; {name} warns that old methods may no longer support a fine conclusion.
advice.faction_aligned: The {faction} are ready to treat {name}'s reading as their case in council.
advice.reputation: {name} notes that a ship famous for wonder or restraint will be offered different evidence by outsiders.
advice.obligation: {name} asks whether {obligation} limits what may ethically be tested here.
advice.vacant: The Scientist post is vacant; the council has observations but no named scientific adviser.

name: Agronomist
description: Feeds a thousand mouths from hydroponic decks.

advice.steady: {name}, the {skill_band} {post}, counts the harvests this choice consumes as well as the mouths it serves.
advice.novice: {name} can promise the next crop, not yet the resilience of the tenth.
advice.expert: {name} weighs seed stock, labour, and hunger across a generation rather than one ration cycle.
advice.strained: The green-deck craft is fading; {name} warns that projected yields rest on knowledge the ship is losing.
advice.faction_aligned: The {faction} work the same decks and will rally behind {name}'s account of the stores.
advice.reputation: {name} asks whether the ship's known habits will make others share provisions—or hide them.
advice.obligation: {name} reserves part of the calculation for {obligation}; promised mouths still count.
advice.vacant: The Agronomist post is vacant; no named officer can vouch for the harvest forecast.

name: Security Chief
description: Keeps the peace between decks and generations.

advice.novice: {name} sees where disorder may begin, but cautions that force can create the crowd it expects.
advice.expert: {name} distinguishes deterrence, mediation, and punishment—and warns they purchase different kinds of quiet.
advice.strained: The peacekeeping discipline is weak; {name} doubts the watch can contain every consequence the council names.
advice.faction_aligned: The {faction} fill the loudest decks, and {name}'s affiliation makes both trust and suspicion sharper.
advice.reputation: {name} warns that the ship's reputation will decide whether a show of force reads as resolve or threat.
advice.obligation: {name} names {obligation} as a standing claim on the council's good faith.
advice.vacant: The Security Chief post is vacant; no named officer can answer for order after the decision.

name: Navigator
description: Owns the burn schedule and the century-long course.

advice.steady: {name}, the {skill_band} {post}, asks what destination remains reachable after this detour.
advice.novice: {name} trusts the plotted leg but warns that the farther consequences are still estimates.
advice.expert: {name} lays the immediate opening beside the fuel, time, and futures it closes.
advice.strained: The navigational record is incomplete; {name} warns that the safest-looking course may rest on inherited error.
advice.faction_aligned: The {faction} see their own future in {name}'s course and will press that reading hard.
advice.reputation: {name} notes that the ship's name travels ahead of it and changes which routes remain open.
advice.obligation: {name} keeps {obligation} on the chart; a promise with a date is also a waypoint.
advice.vacant: The Navigator post is vacant; the council has no serving navigator to speak for the long course.
